capability_profile.retained_database_profile: sequence 9 one-table nullable signed-i32 database with snapshots and scalar literal-list IN/NOT IN
semantics: an empty table behaves as an empty set, including for a NULL left operand
a matching non-NULL row decides true for IN and false for NOT IN
without a match, a stored NULL yields NULL
a NULL left operand against a non-empty table yields NULL
direct table and scalar-subquery spellings are behaviorally equivalent
capability_profile.input_staging_contract: SQL bytes are staged in host-owned non-overlapping memory; all sequence-10 campaigns used the unused high-memory region beginning at 32768.
unsupported_expression_forms: projected subqueries other than SELECT * FROM t1
unary plus, uppercase NULL, or whitespace variants outside the declared grammar
broader_unsupported_database_features: ordering, grouping, joins, aggregates, indexes, constraints, and transactions
